title: detect duplicated definitions instead of relying on noticing them

AC1.note: scripts/find-duplicate-definitions.ts runs as 'bun run dupes' and reports each literal with every file it appears in

AC2.note: findDuplicates tests: a pattern in two files is reported with both; one in a single file is not

AC3.note: both prototype false positives covered, plus interpolated URLs, division, division inside a template, string content between slashes, and obj.await followed by division

AC4.note: MIN_STRING_LENGTH = 24, named with the reasoning; tested above and below the threshold

AC5.note: TEST_PATH excludes tests and fixtures by default; --include-tests documented; collectSourceFiles takes the flag

AC6.note: every test runs against synthetic sources; findDuplicates takes its reader as a parameter so nothing touches the repository

AC7.note: reports and exits 0; --fail documented in the header and implemented; nothing wired into CI in this flow

AC8.note: journal records all 19: two real leftovers fixed here (permission regexes, git-ref allowlist), twelve handed to the next flow as the pane-parsing set, and two named as acceptable

AC9.note: bun run typecheck clean; bun run lint 0 errors (208 warnings, pre-existing); 654 unit tests pass, none skipped or removed

AC10.note: the header names paraphrase, concatenated/template literals, and scan-not-parser as what it cannot see
